content:
Jesus is the reality of the Fullness of God in Everything. He is the Manifestation of God's love expressed in a thing, person or place. He is Perfection, and the upward pull of all things towards God's perfect will! 
*#Teleiosis*
*#IrisToIris*

Jesus doesn't try to Perfect us, He is our Perfection. Perfection is not something that God does, rather it is how He is, it is His reality and truth. This is why Perfection cannot be partial, it cannot come in parts, but just as Christ was raised from the dead, one is brought into the fullness of Perfection instantly. 
*#Teleiosis*
*#IrisToIris*

Death is not the end, the Ressurrection of Jesus Christ from the dead changed the reality of all things, death is no longer the end because Jesus Christ defeated death and has become the final destination to which all things tend. The Original purpose of God is to restore all things to Himself in Christ, this is the Power of the Resurrection.
*#Teleiosis*
*#IrisToIris*

The greatest display of God's power and Person was manifested in the raising of Jesus Christ from the dead, Jesus didn't come back to life; He ressurected! He was the first one to come into a manifestation of Perfection, He is the Head of all things, and to Him all things tend. 
*#Teleiosis*
*#IrisToIris*

God sent Jesus not just to give us tickets to Heaven, but that the Kingdom of Heaven may manifest through us to all creation. You are called to manifest His Fullness and to perfect creation. What the Father desires is Perfection for all things. 
*#Teleiosis*
*#IrisToIris*

God can only give of His Fullness, whatever is partial does not come from Him, all He does is Perfection! He Perfects that which concerns you. Perfection is Now!
*#Teleiosis*
*#IrisToIris*

What is born of God overcomes the world, that is the nature of all things that are born of God! Jesus at the Resurrection is made a Son forever by birth, He doesn't pray for victory, he doesn't ask for it, or press in to it, He IS the victory of death and all the struggles in the universe, the same is true for all that are born of God, as He is so are we. Perfection 
*#Teleiosis*
*#IrisToIris*

The Glory of the Lord shines through every form of limitation. The Resurrected Christ cannot be hindered or resisted by anything, He has not opposite or rival, He brings all things into Perfection. This is how we are called to live, not to be affected by anything but to affect everything around us.
*#Teleiosis*
*#IrisToIris*

The Lord in the Ressurrection delivered Creation from death, He removed the ability to lose from all things He gave us life unending. This is the Divine reality that fills all things, the resurrection is the removal of anything that can be corrupted. 
*#Teleiosis*
*#IrisToIris*

Perfection is not a result of effort, it is the Manifestation of the Resurrection. It comes about by the working of the Power that raised Jesus from the dead. The power that brings all things into oneness with Christ! 
*#Teleiosis*
*#IrisToIris*

Man has not yet walked in the experience of what Christ did in His Resurrection. The freedom of all Creation is in the revelation of the Ressurrection, as the body of Christ it is up to us to come into the fullness of our upward calling in God, to manifest as the Resurrected Christ to all creation. This is Perfection! 
*#Teleiosis*
*#IrisToIris*

Being raised together with Christ is not a metaphor, it is a reality that God wrought when He raised Jesus from the dead, it is an instant manifestation of the Resurrection, the upward call of God is for us to experience this Truth, to come into Perfect Oneness with Christ! To be as He is! 
*#Teleiosis*
*#IrisToIris*

God's original purpose is Oneness with Himself, the past age has taught us to pursue closeness, but the Perfect State of the risen Christ is one that dictates Oneness with God, being Conformed into the image of the One who is the express image of the invisible God! 
*#Teleiosis*
*#IrisToIris*

To deny Perfection is to deny the Perfection of Jesus Christ and to say only Jesus is perfect is to deny the full work of Christ and His Ressurrection. What God wrought in Christ was not just for Jesus, it was for all creation, through Him God has brought Perfection and it's reality to all things.
*#Teleiosis*
*#IrisToIris*

Going to Heaven is not the goal, the goal is to bring it's reality to all creation, we are the only beings through whom Kingdom expansion takes place. The Perfect reality of Heaven is not something you should desire to merely see, but rather we are called to manifest it.
*#Teleiosis*
*#IrisToIris*

The Power of Love brings all things into Perfection, this is the power that Raised Jesus from the dead, anything that is touched by Love is brought into it's Perfect state, that is to say it is made as Jesus is; this is because God is Love! 
*#Teleiosis*
*#IrisToIris*

What God did when He raised Jesus from the dead is not something to be preached, it is a reality to be experienced by all Creation, the Lord has given us a divine reality the goes beyond the scope of words and takes us into the very manifestation of God's life and nature; this is the experience and reality of the new creation, one that is Perfected in Christ! 
*#Teleiosis*
*#IrisToIris*

Giving your life to Jesus is not done so that He can use you like a tool or piece of equipment. The desire of God is to conform us into the image of His Son, that we may manifest His fullness to all Creation. The greatest tragedy is son's begging to to used as slaves in an attempt to please their Father. 
#Teleiosis
#IrisToIris

How much of your assignment have you left to chance? That is the amount that will not get done, you cannot just wait for the important things in your life to just happen, you have to engage and press into them, Perfection has been made available to us we are to be it's manifestation. 
*#Teleiosis*
*#IrisToIris*

The eternal purpose of God is to manifest Himself through His Son's and Jesus showed us how. In the resurrection we see the express image of God revealed to all creation, this is who we are called to be. Perfection is the fulfillment of the desires of God's heart for you, that is to be Conformed into the image of His Son.
*#Teleiosis*
*#IrisToIris*

In Perfection nothing can be lost, broken or changed! If you feel you have received something from God that is breakable, you must let it go, for the glory of a higher reality that cannot be broken. This is the Glory of the Resurrection, the manifestation of Perfection. We have received a Kingdom the cannot be shaken.
*#Teleiosis*
*#IrisToIris*

We have not been fashioned after the likeness of Jesus of Nazereth, we are being conformed into the image of the risen Christ. Creation has been groaning for the manifested sons, those who display and live out the Resurrection Life of Christ, this is Perfection. It's time to Manifest true Sonship!
*#Teleiosis*
*#IrisToIris*

The Perfect state of the Risen Christ is the Original call and purpose of God for all Creation, it is through us that the Father is manifesting His divine desire and the counsel of His will to all. Christ is the head of all things and the original intent of God!
*#Teleiosis*
*#IrisToIris*

If the transgressions of Adam in the Garden affected all mankind and the creatures placed under him then we equally need to understand the Power of the Resurrection of Jesus affects all Creation, and the manifestation of the Resurrection will be experienced when man rises to the knowledge and revelation being raised together with Christ; this is the Manifestation of the Son's of God.
*#Teleiosis*
*#IrisToIris*

The Revelation about having a law is that, in that very law is the power to break it, by resisting it's established structure or by coming under another system one may break free from it. The Law by nature has a downward thrust to keep one under it! Perfection is not a law, neither does it come by a law, it is the irresistible Power of an Endless life. 
*#Teleiosis*
*#IrisToIris*

True freedom comes from being free to manifest the fullness of Christ. Christ cannot be bound by any system, addiction or law, if you are to soar into the blessedness of freedom you must come into the Ressurrection of Jesus Christ, it is the place of Perfect Rest were you are not struggling with anything. 
*#Teleiosis*
*#IrisToIris*

Just as the non-believer cries out for God and His salvation, all of Creation cries out for Perfection that comes by the Manifestation of the Son's of God, Apostle Paul also reveals that even the believer is groaning within himself for the "adoption of the body"; this is the Life and Immortality that God has given us through the Resurrection of Christ from the dead. The which is PERFECT is Come! 
*#Teleiosis*
*#IrisToIris*

The central theme of the Bible is not going to Heaven, neither is it healing, miracles financial success or greatness; the Journey of the Bible shows us God's desire to restore all things to Himself, to bring the entire creation to Perfection. This is what miracles point to, it is what the influence and greatness God gives us is all about, Perfecting all things in Christ!
*#Teleiosis*
*#IrisToIris*

The resurrected Christ is not a rescuer or a provider, He is the Perfection of all things, He is the original point to which all creation tends, He is the Son of God in whose image every believer is being conformed, He is the Perfect state of Creation as God intended in eternity past.
*#Teleiosis*
*#IrisToIris*

The fullness of God cannot be defined in a religious context. We are coming out of an age where men believed that the only place to manifest and experience God is in a religious setting. God is showing up industries, in Governance, in all spheres of Creation; This is the Perfect manifestation of His fullness! 
*#Teleiosis*
*#IrisToIris*

The revelation that we have had of God is not sufficient to reveal Him in fullness, that is not to say that we need to seek out more of Him, but rather we must change our dimension to see Him from His reality. God doesn't hide Himself, it is man that has sought Him from a plane that will never manifest His fullness! In Perfection we see Christ As He Is! 
*#Teleiosis*
*#IrisToIris*

Religion never produced sons, you cannot pray your way into Sonship. Jesus became the son of God by birth, at His resurrection the Father declared "you are my Son, today I have begotten you". This is how we were brought into Perfection, it is by the power of His ressurrection. 
*#Teleiosis*
*#IrisToIris*

The religious systems we have known cannot bring about Perfection. Corruption cannot inherit incorruption, mortality cannot inherit immortality. Imperfection can never attain perfection, one has to be born of the Resurrection as Jesus was, Perfection is by Birth, not by growth.
*#Teleiosis*
*#IrisToIris*

Jesus is the Lord of all things, this is why in Perfection you don't look at anything as unholy or unclean, the Lord Perfects all things, all creation is subject to the glory of the Resurrected Christ! That which is PERFECT is Come! 
*#Teleiosis*
*#IrisToIris*

What man lost in the Garden is what the death of Jesus purchased back for us. The Ressurrection however is a different state on its own, it is a place of Perfect Oneness with God; it is more than just being reconciled to God, it is the revelation of the of God's Original desire for all Creation. 
*#Teleiosis*
*#IrisToIris*

Jesus is more than just an example, He is the fullness of how the Father desires us to be, just as Adam was the fullness of the first Creation and the head of it, Jesus is the Head of the New Creations, all things are in His state. In Christ all things are brought into Perfection! 
*#Teleiosis*
*#IrisToIris*

What the Father manifested when He raised Jesus from the dead, is the Perfect State of all things. Jesus is the Manifestation of Perfection, He is the head of all things; this is what the son's of God are called to manifested. The resurrection is not a message, it is the reality of existence in Christ! 
*#Teleiosis*
*#IrisToIris*

The death of Jesus on the Cross, dealt with what was lost by Adam at the fall, in he Ressurrection God dealt with all creation. Each and every facet of Creation was affected by the resurrection, and it is through us who have come into the resurrection (Manifested Son's of God) that Creation is restored to God's Original intent; PERFECTION!  
*#Teleiosis*
*#IrisToIris*

Anything that can be lost, shaken or changed is not Perfect! In the Ressurrection there is no loss of health, wealth, time or life, the reality of Perfection stands by the power of an endless life! This is our call to be conformed into the image of the Risen Christ! 
*#Teleiosis*
*#IrisToIris*

Seeing Jesus is not just about being able to tell what He looks like, it's about being conformed into His exact image as you behold Him, this is the intimacy of knowing Him Face to Face, seeing eye to eye, entering into His reality Iris to Iris. This is the state to which the Father is conforming all Creation; Perfection, that which is PERFECT is Come. 
*#Teleiosis*
*#IrisToIris*

The Perfection is not an anointing or a message, it is the state to which all things are brought to in the Risen Christ! God in Christ is pulling all things into a permanent state that is in His nature and class until the Kingdoms of this world are become the Kingdom of Our God and of His Christ.
*#Teleiosis*
*#IrisToIris*

The Face of Jesus is not one of a task Master, a boss or a rescuer, when you look into His eyes you see the fullness of God that you all called to manifest to all Creation. To know Him Iris to Iris is to come into the full manifestation of God's Original intent... Perfection! 
*#Teleiosis*
*#IrisToIris*

In Perfection you cannot ask God to do anything for you, all you do in manifest the fullness of who you are to all Creation. Christ is not lacking in any way, He is a life giving spirit to all creation. Rid yourself of the mentality that needs God to do something for you, and come up to be an expression of His Fullness. 
*#Teleiosis*
*#IrisToIris*

Before the dawn of time God had already established the divine Order for all Creation to come into full experience of His reality. When Christ rose from the dead, the activation of God's Original purpose was set into motion, now mankind can be the expression and experience of the Glory of God; Perfection is now a Reality! 
*#Teleiosis*
*#IrisToIris*

Knowledge is what separates people into different classes of life, you will eventually fall into the bracket of your knowledge. What seems impossible to you but is working for others is just a reflection of the knowledge that they possess. Without the knowledge of Perfection it will forever be an impossibility, but through the Gospel Jesus has brought Life and immortality to LIGHT!
*#Teleiosis*
*#IrisToIris*

What Glory do you seek? For all the Glory is Christs'. In their perfect state all things give glory to God, nothing is outside Him, for all things were made through Him and for Him. The desire to live a glorious and fulfilled life that brings Glory to His name, is the desire live in Perfection, to manifest the fullness of what God created you to be. 
*#Teleiosis*
*#IrisToIris*

The Power of God cannot be by chance, it has to be complete every single time He is called upon. Jesus did not die or save mankind by trial and error. The Ressurrection did not happen by chance, it truly was by the full Power of God! There are no doubts or margin of error when it comes to Perfection, it is the doing of God. 
*#Teleiosis*
*#IrisToIris*

Oneness with God is different from being in Him, Oneness speaks of sharing into His very Nature, having the exact expression of His Person, this is an experience in which someone who encounters you has encountered God. That is the desire of God for each one of us in Christ Jesus. 
*Teleoisis*
*#IrisToIris*

God's justice is not to make things fair, but rather it is to bring all things into Christ, were they are beyond reproach and victimization. Herein is true Justice that Christ is manifest in and through all things. This is the end of greed and selfishness and of oppression and abuse. The Justice of Heaven is the Perfection.
*#Teleoisis*
*#IrisToIris*

The glory of God is seeing His Son's walk in the fullness of His very Nature. The Father desires sons who are the express image of His Person. This is Perfection coming into Christs' full stature. Jesus is God's Perfect and original intent for all His Son's. We are comformed into His image.
*#Teleoisis*
*#IrisToIris*
